overview: Halvard Mutual Insurance Group is migrating its legacy on-premises policy administration system to a modern cloud platform to vacate its Oslo data centre before lease expiry. The proposed solution modernizes the legacy monolith into containerized microservices, introduces a modern policyholder self-service portal, and optimizes overnight batch processing. The architecture leverages cloud-native relational databases, managed API gateways, and automated orchestration to ensure high performance, scalability, and regulatory compliance.

customer_objectives.text: Complete migration out of the Oslo data centre before lease expiry while preserving historical policy and claims data.
Compress the overnight batch processing window to improve operational efficiency.
Deliver modern direct digital self-service capabilities to policyholders.
Accelerate product launch velocity to shorten the time required to release new insurance product variants.
